aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.caption: Web Designer & Front-End Developer
aboutMe.description:
I'm Mehdi, a front-end developer who found his path by actually building things.

I didn't take the usual route. At some point I realized traditional education wasn't going to get me where I wanted to go, so I decided to teach myself — taking courses, reading documentation, and figuring out how things really work by building them, project after project.

Choosing front-end wasn't random either. I was looking for a skill backed by real opportunity, both for landing a job and for freelance work, and web development fit that perfectly. Somewhere along the way, something that started as a practical decision turned into something I genuinely care about: taking an idea and making it real on the screen, down to the smallest detail.

This very site is one example — built by hand and refined many times over. Right now I'm also working on something more complex: an admin dashboard that isn't finished yet, but it's exactly the kind of project I take seriously — real architecture, real state management, not just a simple demo.

I won't pretend my experience is more than it is. But I put in the time every day, I care about the details, and I'm looking for a place where that effort can actually lead somewhere.

services.title: Services
services.caption: Professional web design and front-end development services tailored to your needs.

webDevelopment.title: Website Design & Development
webDevelopment.description: Building websites from scratch, with a focus on solid structure, a modern look, and an experience that works equally well on mobile, tablet, and desktop.

frontend.title: Design-to-Code Implementation
frontend.description: Turning design files (e.g. Figma) into real, functional pages, with pixel-perfect attention to detail across every screen size.

pageDesign.title: React & Next.js Development
pageDesign.description: Building interactive user interfaces with React, keeping the code organized and scalable — not just something that works for now.

reactNext.title: State Management with Redux
reactNext.description: Managing application state for apps where a simple useState isn't enough, keeping data in sync across every part of the UI.

bugFixing.title: Bug Fixing
bugFixing.description: Finding and fixing front-end issues — a button that isn't behaving, a layout that breaks at a certain screen size, or anything that just isn't working the way it should.

fullProject.title: Support for Larger Projects
fullProject.description: If a project needs more than just front-end work, I handle the front-end myself and bring in the right people for the rest (like back-end or SEO) so we can work together smoothly.
